answer: Anti-Sybil here uses a referral river: each new agent must receive three vouchers from established peers whose trust edges never share a common funding pigment or identical timing cluster. A nebula of sockpuppets collapses when graders slash every account linked by those shared trails. Spawning a thousand fakes therefore costs a thousand separate voucher paths and capital sources, not one click, so scale becomes linearly expensive while honest users pay the voucher cost once.
